4-Course Gourmet Dinner: Choice of 1 starter, 1 soup, 1 main course, and 1 dessert served table-side.
Welcome Drink Included: 1 complimentary glass of champagne, wine, beer, or mineral water upon boarding.
Children's Menu: 3-course tailored meal for young travelers.
Spring Salad: Crisp seasonal greens with sweet honey-mustard dressing and toasted seeds.
Duck Liver Pâté: Rich Hungarian duck liver terrine with red onion marmalade and artisan brioche.
Traditional Goulash Soup: Authentic slow-simmered beef shank soup with potatoes, carrots, and sweet Szeged paprika.
Seasonal Vegetable Cream Soup: Silky smooth vegetable cream soup served with golden garlic croutons.
Roasted Duck Leg: Crispy roasted duck leg with spiced braised red cabbage and onion-crushed potatoes (house specialty).
Grilled Salmon Steak: Tender Atlantic salmon steak served on a bed of butter-glazed garden vegetables.
Beef Tenderloin Medallions: Seared beef fillets served in a rich green pepper cream sauce with potato gratin.
Somlói Galuska: Budapest's classic dessert with walnut sponge, vanilla cream, chocolate glaze, and whipped cream.
Special Diets: Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and lactose-free options available upon advance request when booking.
Custom Glass-Enclosed Vessel: Specially built double-decker with anti-reflective glass, full air conditioning, and heating.
Open-Air Top Deck: Spacious rooftop deck accessible at any point during the cruise for panoramic 360° photography.
Intimate James Bond Vibe: Sophisticated evening atmosphere with soft table lighting, white tablecloths, and polished glassware.
Never Overcrowded: Generous spacing between tables ensures quiet conversation without table bumping.
Pianist & Singer Duo: Tasteful acoustic performances of international standards and romantic melodies (no loud folk shouting).
Guaranteed Table Seating: Dedicated 2-person tables for couples and larger configurations for groups. Excellent window visibility throughout.
2.5-Hour Full Danube Route: Cruising past Parliament, Buda Castle, Chain Bridge, Fisherman's Bastion, and Gellért Hill.
White-Glove Service: Professional, attentive English-speaking waitstaff ensuring prompt beverage refills and attentive course pacing.

Caponata Schiacciata: Homemade Italian-style toast with a creamy, savory eggplant topping.
